independent_computation.step_1_what_the_scenario_pins: The scenario id encodes the Syndra Transcendent stack count: splinters = 60. Syndra's Splinters of Wrath thresholds in the cached wiki text are 40 (Q second charge), 60 (W bonus true damage), 80 (E scatter/slow), 100 (R execute), 120 (Transcendence, +15% AP). 60 therefore sits at-or-above exactly two gates: the Q charge gate (40) and the W true-damage gate (60).
independent_computation.step_2_is_a_second_Q_cast_available_at_6: YES. Q Dark Sphere carries 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' 60 >= 40, so Syndra holds up to 2 stocked Dark Sphere charges. The cached Q record gives rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7] (a charge restocks every 7 s) and castTime = 'none', so from a full-charge state both charges are castable back-to-back inside one rotation with no cooldown gate between them. Nothing in the cached text conditions the second charge on anything beyond the 40-splinter threshold.
independent_computation.step_3_is_the_second_cast_a_SETUP_cast: YES. Q 'conjures a Dark Sphere ... The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.' Every other Syndra slot consumes those spheres: W 'telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere ... and holds ... Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target'; E 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units ... Targets hit are also stunned'; R 'conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones ... each dealing magic damage upon hit.' Sphere creation is the applier side of the setup/consume relation and must precede the consumers - so a second sphere-placing cast belongs in the setup sequence, not after it.
independent_computation.step_4_slot_label: The engine's own slot name for the second charge is literally 'Q2': data/champion-audit/batch-6.json records Syndra module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] with the note 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' and gap_summary 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge'; data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json repeats '40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'. So the string 'Q2' is the correct label for the element, not an invented token.
independent_computation.step_5_what_the_absence_cost: Omitting Q2 at splinters=60 drops a whole Dark Sphere cast from the rotation: 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP) magic damage by Q rank, plus one extra live sphere on the field for R, which 'grabs up to 4 nearby live ones' at 80/120/160 (+20% AP) per sphere. Two Q casts feed R 2 live spheres -> 5 spheres barraged instead of 4 (3 conjured + 1). Both effects are strictly positive, so the pre-change rotation understated the 60-splinter scenario.
independent_computation.conclusion: At splinters = 60 the second Dark Sphere charge is unlocked (60 >= 40), immediately castable (2 stocked charges, castTime none, recharge 7 s), and is a sphere-placing setup cast that must appear in the rotation's setup sequence. A setup list that contains a 'Q2' element is the state the cached wiki text supports; a setup list with no Q2 element at all is not.

caveats: Positional convention not independently verifiable: the exported evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md) fixes WHICH casts exist at splinters=60 and that the second Dark Sphere charge is a setup-side cast, but it does not define the rotation receipt's setup-list ordering rule or whether the [i] index in this leaf path is 0- or 1-based. Both readings place Q2 legitimately: 0-based ['Q','W','Q2'] / ['Q','...','Q2'] or 1-based ['Q','Q2']. What the wiki cache does settle is that a Q2 element must be present in the 60-splinter setup sequence and its absence is a real omission.

docs/math-foundations.md documents shared-timeline cast scheduling (section 1.1, 'resolved greedily by cast order') but says nothing about charge-stocked abilities or the setup/consume derivation, so it neither supports nor contradicts the leaf; the whole judgement rests on the cached wiki text.

Aside (not this leaf): splinters=60 also sits exactly on the W gate - 'Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage' - so this scenario is coupled on two thresholds at once; if the W true-damage term is not also live in this scenario, that is a separate defect worth checking.
